Since their entry into force in  January 1995, portions of these agreements have been amended and rectified  several times and some were terminated. The texts reproduced here do not have the legal standing of the original documents which are entrusted and kept at the WTO Secretariat in Geneva. Introduction The WTO agreements contain rights and  obligations that apply to WTO members in general. Some of these agreements also  include “ schedules ”  of commitments specific to individual members. More When signing the Marrakesh Agreement,  ministers adopted the Marrakesh Ministerial Declaration to formally conclude the Uruguay Round. They  also signed a Final Act ,  which contained various Uruguay Round ministerial decisions and  declarations , and the Understanding on Commitments in Financial Services in an annex. These documents have been published in the WTO Ministerial Conferences — Key Outcomes publication. Together with the Marrakesh  Agreement, which was also annexed to the Final Act, they embody the results of  the Uruguay Round. The Marrakesh Agreement Establishing the WTO and its Annexes The Marrakesh Agreement Establishing  the World Trade Organization was signed in Marrakesh on 15 April 1994, and  entered into force on 1 January 1995. It contains four annexes. These address  trade in goods ( Annex 1A )  and services ( Annex 1B ),  trade-related aspects of intellectual property rights ( Annex 1C ),  procedures for dispute settlement among members ( Annex 2 ),  and a mechanism to review members' trade policies ( Annex 3 ). Following the termination of two agreements  in the late 1990s, Annex 4 to  the Marrakesh Agreement contains two “plurilateral” trade agreements  applicable among certain members only: the Agreement on Trade in Civil Aircraft and the Agreement on Government Procurement . The Marrakesh Agreement and its  Annexes, as amended or rectified up to September 2025, have been published in The WTO  Agreements publication. More Since 1995, specific portions of the  Marrakesh Agreement have been amended or rectified. The amendments included the  insertion, in 2017, of the Trade Facilitation Agreement into Annex 1A, the amendment of the TRIPS Agreement in 2017 to improve developing economies' access  to medicines, and the extension of review cycles under the Trade Policy Review Mechanism , which  took effect in 2019. In 2022, an amendment to the Marrakesh Agreement was adopted for the  insertion of the Agreement  on Fisheries Subsidies into Annex 1A. This amendment entered into force on 15  September 2025 and is currently  open for acceptance by members. There have also been amendments to the plurilateral Agreement on Government Procurement and the Agreement on Trade in Civil Aircraft . Both the original and amended versions of these  agreements are available below. A detailed description of how the  Marrakesh Agreement entered into force and how it has been rectified and  amended is contained in the introduction to the Status of WTO Legal Instruments publication. Accession protocols, which also form an  integral part of the Marrakesh Agreement, are available in the accessions section  of the WTO website. Key documents relating to negotiations  among certain members resulting in co-ordinated changes to relevant members'  goods and services schedules are available through the dedicated page regarding  members' schedules . X Note The Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies (the Agreement) was adopted by the WTO Ministerial Conference on 17 June 2022 (see WT/MIN(22)/33WT/L/1144 ). The Protocol Amending the WTO Agreement done at Geneva on 17 June 2022 (the Protocol), inserting the Agreement into Annex 1A, is open for acceptance by WTO members and, in accordance with Article X:3 of the WTO Agreement and paragraph 4 of the Protocol, will enter into force once two thirds of the WTO members have deposited their instrument of acceptance. At that time, the Agreement will apply only to the WTO members that will have accepted it. In respect of each member that accepts the Agreement after its entry into force, the Agreement will take effect upon acceptance, in accordance with Article X:3 of the WTO Agreement. X Note The original text of the Annex can be consulted in the following GATT documents: Instrument No. 155 and LET/1064 . The Annex was modified and rectified in 1983 (GATT documents: AIR/34 , AIR/39 and LET/1357 ), 1984 (GATT documents: AIR/43 and LET/1390 ), and 1985 (GATT documents: AIR/45 , AIR/48 and LET/1418 ). Subsequently, the Annex was replaced through amendment protocols in 1986 (GATT documents: AIR/62 and LET/1511 ). The different versions of the Annex are only binding on those Signatories that have accepted the relevant amendment protocols. Schedules and TFA commitments Four agreements  annexed to the Marrakesh  Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization include concessions  and commitments specific to individual members: the GATT , the GATS , the Agreement on Trade Facilitation , and  the Agreement on  Government Procurement .
